name.value: Empty Keg Brew House Tasting Room

description.value: Empty Keg Brew House is a family-run craft brewery and tasting room in Merritt, BC, established in 2019 and situated on the Southern Interior Ale Trail. The brewery has created over 67 varieties of house-crafted beer since opening, with a current tap list spanning stouts, lagers, pale ales, hard seltzers, and non-alcoholic options. Cyclists will find a relaxed atmosphere with an expanded outdoor patio, a casual food menu of burgers and shareable plates, and a policy allowing outside restaurant food to be brought in.

raw_osm.name: Empty Keg Brew House Tasting Room

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and confirms the business as an active craft brewery tasting room at 2190 Voght St, Merritt, BC, with phone (250) 315-BEER matching OSM's +1-250-315-2337. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via growler fills and canned beer options described on the Drinks page. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record has no address field; address sourced entirely from website ('2190 Voght St, Merritt, BC').
OSM name includes 'Tasting Room' suffix but website branding uses 'Empty Keg Brew House' without that suffix — minor discrepancy.
Website footer spells name as 'Empty Keg Brewhouse' (one word) in some places vs. 'Brew House' (two words) used elsewhere — inconsistent branding but same business.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active craft brewery tasting room with food menu, outdoor patio, and growler takeout on the Southern Interior Ale Trail — a natural and useful stop for touring cyclists passing through Merritt.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tags outdoor_seating=yes, corroborated by website announcement of an expanded southern patio. The business also participates in the Southern Interior Ale Trail (video embed on homepage).
